title: Scheduled Irrigation TCS7+DCS2 Single-Node SSDI Readiness Contract

selected_restricted_profile.calendar_policy: window membership supplied explicitly as management input; no hidden midnight/day-start assumption
selected_restricted_profile.table_policy: 2..7 finite strictly increasing DVS knots; partial tables fail closed when runtime DVS exceeds the final supplied knot

required_source_identity.outer_order: scheduled trigger evaluated only after fixed-event precedence and only when explicit irrigation/schedule/crop/window gates are true

target_translation.tcs7_table: immutable DVS/head table in dimensionless DVS and cm pressure head
target_translation.dcs2_table: legacy FID mm values translated by adapter to immutable cm depths before entering process
target_translation.irr_rate: legacy mm/h translated by adapter to cm/day before entering process
target_translation.sensor_node: legacy dcrit/zbotcp lookup translated outside process to immutable validated node index
target_translation.ssdi_node: legacy ss_irr_z/zbotcp lookup translated outside process to immutable validated single node index

afgen_admission_scope.target_semantics: endpoint-first clamp plus piecewise linear interpolation over explicit populated knots
afgen_admission_scope.reason: legacy calls length 14 even after partial table reads; target must not persist or depend on stale SAVE-array tail state

hydraulic_read.requirement: read-only committed process_hydraulic_view_t pressure_head with validated active_nodes and sensor-node bounds

ssdi_source.requirement: precomputed positive single-node source accepted without direct HeadCalc mutation

transaction.requirement: active scheduled-event state changes are candidate-only until commit; rejected/split trials leave committed state unchanged

mass.requirement: positive single-node SSDI irrigation is external inflow exactly once in accepted authoritative interval accounting

legacy_dependency_cut.observed: legacy irrigation executes root-zone capacity and watcon calculations for every tcs>1 before TCS7 evaluation
legacy_dependency_cut.qualification_caveat: structural readiness does not claim that removing legacy incidental/global side effects is scientifically invisible; later independent F-VQ must verify observable runtime identity

multi_node_ssdi_hold.finding: scheduled SSDI assigns the same rate to every selected node without dividing DCS2 depth by node count, whereas fixed-event SSDI explicitly divides fixed depth over nodes before execution
multi_node_ssdi_hold.resolution_required: separate source-theory reconciliation and independent mass qualification before multi-node scheduled SSDI admission

immutable_parameters: DCS2 explicit-knot depth table in cm
persistent_dynamic_state: active scheduled-event start/end only while continuation is required

readiness_gate_must_prove: exact B0/B1.10 functions.f90 and irrigation.f90 identities are pinned and B1.10 patches do not modify them
AFGEN restricted deterministic table semantics are explicit
exact FSI17 process hydraulic view blob is present
exact FMR07 committed view binding is present and candidate/checkpoint view access remains absent
existing SSDI source path remains present
F-VQ18 independently admits the existing restricted SSDI mass route exactly once without implying scheduled TCS/DCS admission
selected seam is single-node SSDI so unresolved scheduled multi-node mass semantics cannot enter
no unqualified surface gird-to-nird route is required
root-zone/watcon calculations are not required as data dependencies of TCS7+DCS2 outputs
all TCS7+DCS2 inputs can be assigned to parameters, management forcing, committed hydraulic view or compact process state
no calendar or day counter is silently inferred from generic solver interval duration
no F-MR backend source is modified by this readiness unit

after_pass.production_scope: smallest pure process seam only; do not modify F-MR backend or F-MR08 lineage
after_pass.independent_scientific_admission: required in a later F-VQ unit
